title: Inventory Ledger
prompt:
Process the following inventory events in order. Each record has stock and reserved quantities; available = stock - reserved. A skipped event has no effect.

Initial state:
A stock=7 reserved=2; B stock=5 reserved=1; C stock=4 reserved=0;
D stock=6 reserved=3; E stock=3 reserved=1; F stock=8 reserved=2.

Operation rules:
- receive(X,n): always applies; stock += n.
- reserve(X,n): applies only if available >= n; reserved += n.
- release(X,n): applies only if reserved >= n; reserved -= n.
- ship(X,n): applies only if reserved >= n; reserved -= n and stock -= n.
- transfer_available(X,Y,n): applies only if X.available >= n; X.stock -= n and Y.stock += n. Reserved quantities do not move.

Events:
E1 reserve(A,4)
E2 transfer_available(A,C,2)
E3 release(D,2)
E4 ship(B,2)
E5 receive(E,3)
E6 reserve(E,4)
E7 ship(A,3)
E8 transfer_available(C,F,3)
E9 release(E,2)
E10 reserve(F,8)

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"events":[{"id":"E1","status":"applied"}, ...],"final_state":{"A":{"stock":0,"reserved":0}, ...}}}
Include E1-E10 in order and exactly records A-F in final_state. Use status "applied" or "skipped".
